scope: Local repair qualifications only; original source issue ledger and source bytes are unchanged.

W11-L51-Q015.sourceClaim: The internal-sensor description is presented without noting sensorless commutation alternatives.
W11-L51-Q015.basis: The source describes a sensored configuration, not a necessary definition of every brushless system.
W11-L51-Q015.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q017.sourceClaim: The source says AC motors are used infrequently because precise control was historically difficult, without specifying the historical scope.
W11-L51-Q017.basis: Do not extrapolate an older generalization into an absolute statement about current robotic drives.
W11-L51-Q017.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q020.sourceClaim: The magnetic-gripper box says metal parts without stating the required magnetic-material compatibility.
W11-L51-Q020.basis: The source’s metal-sheet example should not be generalized to all metals.
W11-L51-Q020.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q023.sourceClaim: F/T contact sensing and tactile contact sensing are split across categories without explaining the context-dependent distinction.
W11-L51-Q023.basis: Contact measurements cross the simple internal/external boundary; source labels should not become an unsupported universal law.
W11-L51-Q023.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q033.sourceClaim: The cloud example describes GPU resources as unlimited and robot power as low without the necessary resource and communication qualifications.
W11-L51-Q033.basis: The cloud path ranges from 8 to 20 ms before outage handling, while the supplied local bound is 8 ms. More remote compute does not remove communication constraints.
W11-L51-Q033.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q051.sourceClaim: The action row directly equates PWM duty percentage with the same percentage of motor speed without a load/control model.
W11-L51-Q051.basis: The table’s action example is illustrative. A measured or designed closed-loop mapping must be distinguished from an assumed proportional open-loop speed.
W11-L51-Q051.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q059.sourceClaim: The sampling-rate row asserts a required IMU rate from only the policy step frequency, without signal-bandwidth or system assumptions.
W11-L51-Q059.basis: With B=40 Hz, the supplied ideal requirement is f_s>80 Hz, which 100 Hz satisfies. The policy rate alone does not impose 200 Hz; anti-aliasing, timestamps, estimation and control timing remain separate design considerations.
W11-L51-Q059.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q071.sourceClaim: The summary calls six-DOF articulated arms most flexible without defining the comparison or reach/singularity qualifications.
W11-L51-Q071.basis: The declared reach bound excludes A. At B, rank five limits local instantaneous motion but does not make the current pose nonexistent. Six joint coordinates alone do not establish arbitrary workspace reach or nonsingularity.
W11-L51-Q071.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.

W11-L51-Q072.sourceClaim: The source says the gap originates in hardware imperfections without acknowledging other simulation/model/environment mismatches.
W11-L51-Q072.basis: A mismatch in contact/environment modelling can cause different behavior without broken hardware. Hardware nonidealities are one contributor, not an exhaustive definition of the sim-to-real gap.
W11-L51-Q072.method: Retain the printed wording and evaluate the explicitly stated interpretation or qualification, not an unannounced correction.
